original: ��������Is this... the Village of\nBeginnings?
We're back!
Hey, the village is back to\nnormal!
Whoa, there's so many DigiEggs\neverywhere!
Hey, wait for me!
Now all the dead Digimon can be\nreborn...
Thank goodness...
And so ends the prophecy inscribed\nin the ancient ruins...
First, what returned was the\nisland, and that island created a\nnew sky and sea and land...
So what does that mean?
In other words, the Digimon world\nis being recreated.
Shall we take a photo to\ncommemorate the occasion,\neveryone?
A picture? Why not?
Good idea!
I agree!
Talk to me whenever you are ready!
Okay!
Then I shall take the picture.
Please do!
Ready, guys?
Say cheese!
Aaaaah!
What happened?
It hatched!
How cute!
So you're leaving, no matter what?
I'm proud to be a Virus-type,\ny'know! Vaccine and Data-types\nlike y'all make my stomach turn!
All right, see ya!
...He left.
He's just trying to look cool...
Oh, how nostalgic!
This is where we spent our first\nnight in this world!
Man, a lot's happened since we\ncame here, but I'm really glad we\ndid.
We won't have any regrets going\nhome!
Jou...
Oh. Oh, no. I shouldn't have said\nthat...
Hey...
What?
We still have quite a bit of\nsummer break left...
I think I'll stay here for the\nrest of it.
Oh, good idea!
I'll stay here if Yamato does!
Me, too! Is that okay, Taichi?
Yeah!
I'd like to do so as well.
Me, too!
Me, too! We've got tons of time!
Indeed. If one day here is\nequivalent to one second in our\nworld...
I can do it in my head! Uh... Four\nthousand and thirty-two days. So\nabout a hundred and ten years!
Seriously?!
That's great! We can go on another\nadventure!
Yeah!
All right, let's go! Our new\nadventure starts now!
...Huh?
It's a solar eclipse...
Children, I've got some news for\nyou about that eclipse.
Good news or bad news?
...Probably bad news.
But it's just a solar eclipse,\nisn't it?
The eclipse's shadow is the gate\nto your world.
The eclipse will end in around two\nhours.
Then why don't we just wait for\nthe next gate?
Yeah! After all, we've got a\nhundred and ten years left of\nsummer break!
But that was because of\nApocalymon...
Now, the flow of time in your\nworld and our world is the same.
What?!
So what happens if we stay?
Yamato...
This world may consider you\nforeign objects and delete your\ndata.
So...
Unfortunately...
When you get back, take care of\nyour mom.
Yeah... And besides, I need to\nthank you, Piyomon...
My mom and I were having a hard\ntime seeing eye-to-eye, but I\nthink we'll fix it because of you.
I think we'll be able to get along\nfine from now on.
Really?
Really!
I'm so happy to hear that, Sora! I\nwas worried that maybe I was\nalways bothering you...
Of course not! Not at all!\nPiyomon...\nPiyomon...
Okay, we might not have\nnecessarily been the best fighting\nduo, but...
...It was still pretty fun.
I think so too! And by the way,\ngood luck on your studies when you\nget home.
Yeah?
What?
Let's shake hands.
Huh? ...Okay, why not.
...huh!
What?
So you *do* have hands!
Tentomon...
Koushirou...
I... am... truly thankful to you.
Oi, oi, oi!
You're always bein' so formal and\npolite with me, Koushirou, even\nnow...
S-Sorry. But then what should I\nsay at a time like this?
Well, it's hard to say, but... you\nshouldn't be forcin' yourself.
No problem bein' all formal if\nthat's the way you wanna say it.
Well, the words'll come easy to\nyou someday.
Do you think so? I hope so...
Waaaaaaah! Waaaaaaaah!
Waaaaaaaah... Don't cry, Takeru...
Waaaaaaah... But... But... we\nwon't be able to see each other\nagain...
That's not true...\nYour world and my world run\non the same time...
...so we'll meet again sometime!
Really?
That's how it was with Devimon,\nright?
Yeah, I really believed we'd meet\nagain...
So believe again!
Okay! We'll meet again. It's a\npromise!
Yeah!
...Hey, Yamato...
...Yeah?
Can you play your harmonica for me\nagain?
...Sure.
...Sure.
...Are you serious, Yamato?!
What's wrong?
...No, it's nothing.
Hey, this was where I lit a fire\nwith my Baby Flame, isn't it?
Yeah! Yamato got mad because it\nscorched his clothes.
...Huh? Was it my fault?
Wait, no, it's because I was\nteasing Gabumon. Hahaha!
Taichiiiiii!
Ahaha... ah... *sob*
Haha... *sob*
...Are you sure?
Yeah.
...Thanks.
Looks good on you.
Really? Okay so... take care,\nHikari.
Until next time.
Next time?
Next time.
Palmon! Palmooooooon!
Whatcha doin', ribbit?
I can't find Palmon. Have you seen\nher?
We haven't, ribbit.
Really? Where did Palmon go... We\ndon't have much time left...
We've completed modifications to\nthe trolley. We're ready to go at \nany time.
Okay! Good job!
Come talk to me when you're done\nsaying your farewells.
Got it, old man!
Indeed!
Have you finished saying your\nfarewells? We've finished on our\nend.
Well...
Can't we have a little more time?
No can do. The gate won't be\nwaiting.
But...
What's wrong?
Palmon's gone.
Palmon... Stupid, stupid, stupid\nPalmon...
Mimi...
Ah! There you are, ribbit!
Mimi's been looking for you,\nribbit.
I know... I don't want to see her.
Why not, ribbit?
If I see her, it's going to hurt\neven more when she leaves! So it's\nbetter if we don't...
Are you sure you're okay with\nthat, ribbit?
Are you *really* sure, ribbit?
You're not gonna regret it,\nribbit?
We're out of time. Please board\nthe trolley.
All right, guys. Take care!
You too, Taichi!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Mimi!
Mimi!
Yeah!
Mimi! I'm sorry!
It's fine! Thank you, Palmon!\nGoodbye!
Mimi! Ack!
Ah!
And for all eight of them, that\nwas the end of their summer\nvacation...
However, the gate would not stay\nclosed forever.
Nor would this be the first - or\nlast - of the Chosen Children's\nadventures.
The gate to the Digimon world\nwill surely open again...
And as long as you do not forget\nthe Digimon, if you wish for it,\nthen within your heart...
Or, perhaps...
Sure! Take a commemorative photo.
Just a bit longer, please.
We're ready to take the\ncommemorative photo at any time. \nAre you done talking to everyone?
Understood! Then I shall call\neveryone here.
Whenever you're ready, come speak\nto me.
This village is gonna be full of\nbabies when these eggs hatch!
I bet!
You're gonna be busy!
With this many eggs? No doubt\nabout it!
All right, I'm gonna have to get\ndown to work!
Which one of these eggs is\nLeomon's? Nah, there's no way I \ncan recognize it.
Isn't it a little early to be\nworrying about that?
He gets lonely if Leomon's not\naround.
S-Shut up!
Which one of these eggs is\nLeomon's...
So what are you gonna do now,\nCentarumon?
I will return to the ruins and\nwatch over this world's\nreconstruction...
so that peace may return to File\nIsland and the surrounding\ncontinents.
We're the ones who brought that\npeaceful world back, aren't we...
Yes, it was thanks to you. You are\nwelcome to visit at any time.
Yeah! We'll drop by for sure!
I'm truly thankful for everything\nyou've done for us.
Hey, old man Gennai! What's with\nthe huge frown?
It's been a while since I've taken\na picture. I'm practicing my\nsmile!
Wait, what? You look like you're\nreally mad.
Old man Gennai's got a scary\nsmile...
Really now? Oh ho ho.
It's been a while since I've taken\na picture. Oh ho ho...
You don't have any lingering\nregrets, do you?
We're ready.
Give us a bit more time...
All right. Bring everyone here,\nthen.
When you're done saying your\nfarewells, come talk to me.
Hey, Yamato!
Oh hey, it's Taichi!
This place is always packed.\nWhat's going on today?
Oh, there's a band coming from\noverseas. They're having a\nconcert.
Wait, so you're going to a\nconcert?
Yeah, I've been a fan for a while.\nI'm thinking of picking up the\nbass, too.
Really? Do you have a band yet?
No, I'm still working on that...
Yeah... you're pretty bad at\ndealing with other people.
Taichi, are you insulting me?
You know, we never managed to\nsettle the score for real when we\nwere in the Digital World!
Okay, wanna go? With what?
Soccer? Cooking? Karaoke?
There's probably more important\nstuff than just that...
You really don't get it, do you?\nNah, forget about it.
Hey! Why are you talking to\nyourself all of a sudden?
Oh, quiet down. I gotta go, so see\nyou later.
Yeah! Have fun at the concert!
I have no idea what Yamato was\ngoing on about...
Taichi!
Hey, Sora! What's up?
Taking care of some errands. What\nabout you?
Forget me! Are you seriously\nquitting soccer?
Sorry, I thought I might try out\nsome other stuff, like tennis.
Tennis? That doesn't suit you at\nall! Come back to soccer!
It's fine! I'm trying to change my\nimage. Like maybe taking off the\nhat and trying on skirts...
Think maybe it'd be better if I\ndidn't? Would that suit me better?
Does it really matter? This way,\nthat way, they're both fine,\naren't they?
Ugh, it was stupid to think you'd\nhave anything useful to say... I'm\ngoing home.
Hey, Sora! Why'd you get angry all\nof a sudden? I don't get it!
Hey, Koushirou!
Hello, Taichi!
You haven't been coming over\nlately. Did something happen?
I've been looking into some things\nrelated to the Vamdemon incident.
Seems like it's had an effect on\nboth the Digital World and the\nreal world.
So you can't come over?
Well, I could, but... I've been\nstuck to my computer more than I\nwas before.
You're looking into the Digital\nWorld, right?
Yes. The battle with Apocalymon\nhad a great impact on the world...
People all over the world have\nbegun to look into that incident.
And you're one of them, right?
Yes, although of course I've kept\nour adventure a secret.
Right now, I'm enjoying myself\nexchanging emails with people all\nover the world.
Huh! I didn't think you'd say\nthat, Koushirou!
Please don't make fun of me!
I mean, when we were at camp, you\nhad this really bad expression on\nyour face whenever we went to bed.
Yes, you might be right.
Right?
I think I simply felt a sense of\ndistance from everyone.
So that's all it was.
Ah! I've received another email!
Well, if something happens in the\nDigital World, tell me as soon as\nyou can.
Of course!
Mimi!
Taichi!
Wow, someone's carrying a lot. Did\nyou go shopping?
I bought all the clothes that I've\nwanted since we got back! And\nmore!
I know, but you gotta draw the\nline somewhere...
I haven't hit that line yet!
Well, today's clothes are lookin'\ngood today, princess!
Hey, don't call me "princess"!
...Hey, you seem to be doing just\nfine.
You know... we had a lot of fun,\nbut a lot of really sad things\nhappened too...
I kept getting upset because of \nall the bad things that happened \nto the Digimon who fought for us.
Yeah...
I guess I'm becoming more like an\nadult, huh?
I remember you were always saying\nstuff along the lines of "I'm\nhungry!"
Hey, don't say that!
Papa and Mama are calling me! See\nyou later, Taichi!
Yeah, see you later!
Taichi!
Jou! Coming back from cram school?
Man, my grades have been going\ndown ever since we got back from\nthe Digital World...
Dad scolded me to death and Mom\nstarted crying. It's been bad.
That's the life of a student who\nlives his life by exams, I\nguess...
Well, it hasn't been that bad.
Huh?!
Maybe I've built some tolerance in \nthe Digital World. I don't faint \nat the sight of blood anymore.
At least, not unless I were losing\nblood from anemia.
Hey, you're making progress!\nYou'll be a great doctor, Jou.
We've all changed a lot ever since\nwe got back from the Digital\nWorld!
I thought I hadn't, so I was\nreally surprised.
Hey, whaddya mean by that? Of\ncourse you're changed.
You think so? In what way?
You're a lot more reliable than\nyou were before!
Yeah, yeah!
Looks like I'll really have to\ntreat you like my senior!
Right, Mr. Kido?
Hey, Taichi! Don't make fun of me!
Sorry, sorry!
Oops! We've been talking for too\nlong. I don't wanna keep my tutor\nwaiting!
Wait, you're *still* studying?
See you later!
Jou! Good luck with your studies!
Hey, Takeru!
Taichi! Long time no see!
Are you visiting Yamato's place?
Yeah! Mom's gonna be late at work,\nso I'm gonna be eating dinner with\nYamato and Dad!
Huh! Do you go to Yamato's place\noften?
No, not really!
Huh, that's surprising. So\nYamato's okay with not seeing you\nas much anymore...
That's not it, Taichi! I'm grown\nup now!
Hahaha! So Yamato's not the one\nwho's grown up, it's you!
I thought I'd be lonely after\nleaving Patamon...
But I'm okay now!
So what caused the change of\nheart?
Our hearts are connected, even if\nwe're reaaaaaaaally far apart!
It's the same for me and Yamato\nand my dad!
Yeah. That's how I feel about\nAgumon, too...
Ah! Yamato's gonna be waiting for\nme! I gotta go!
Yeah! Take care of Yamato!
You take care of Hikari, too!
What are you looking at, Taichi?
Our memorial picture! The one we\ntook with everyone! The old man\nsent it to me by email.
It's been a while.
It all started when you and I met\na Koromon in Hikarigaoka...
You're right.
Hey, how come you remembered that\nand I forgot?
So you've finally realized! I'm\nactually psychic!
Hahaha... Very funny...
But honestly, I'm sure the gate to\nthe Digital World will open again.
Really?
Yeah! And until then, I'm going to\nbe training my body!
Oh! We got an email! Who's it\nfrom?
H-Hey! Stop it! Don't look!
It's from Sora, isn't it? I know\nyou two exchanged email addresses!
Hikari! Have you been peeking at\nmy computer?
I have no idea what you're talking\nabout!
Hey! You just wait right there!
Hey, Gabumon. Say goodbye to\nTaichi.
Yeah... hey, Taichi, when you get\nback, don't forget about us!
Of course I won't!
And I'm sorry for pretending to\ntake off your pelt!
Aw... you don't have to apologize\nfor that, Taichi!
Really? Then next time, why don't\nyou show me what you look like\nunder there?
Hey, Taichi!
Pffffhahaha!
We'll meet again, right?
Thanks for all the times you\nhelped us, Taichi!
I could say the same! Take care,\nPiyomon!
Okay! And make sure you're getting\nalong with Sora.
Haha! You sounded like her mom\nthere just now.
Although you sound like a kid\nwhenever you go looking for her.
He's right!
Ahaha...
And take care of Sora's mom, too.
Take care o' yourself, Taichi!
You too, Tentomon!
Thanks for teaching us all kinds\nof stuff about the Digital World!
Whaddya mean by that? All I do is\njust study stuff.
If we had a school 'ere, I'd love\nto go to one.
S-School... That just brought up a\nwhole ton of bad memories...
Be sure to work hard when you get\nback!
Aha...
You can do it, Taichi!
Guess I can't just secretly sneak\ninto your world, eh?
Huh? Mimi? Where's Palmon?
I've been looking for her, but I\ncan't find her...
What?! Then we gotta go look for\nher!
But Taichi, you need to go soon!
It's okay, Taichi.
Mimi...
Palmon...
Mimi...
Huh! I thought you'd be crying all\nover the place, but you seem to be\ndoing okay.
Of course! I've gotten stronger.
Right?
Yeah... You did a great job\nagainst Piemon!
Yeah! Takeru and I have been\ntraining hard, so there was no way\nhe could have won!
I'll have to make sure you two\ndon't beat me to it, either!
Oh, Taichi!
Ahahaha!
Maybe I could go meet Takeru if I\nevolved...
Are you done saying your goodbyes\nto Jou?
Yeah, I guess!
You don't really seem that worried\nabout Jou...
Well, yeah! I don't really have to\nworry!
Jou's the kind of guy who'll pull\nthings off somehow!
G-Gomamon!
Although it's hard to get him to\ndo anything unless you motivate\nhim.
Hey!
Haha! You two are like a comedy\nduo.
We'll meet again someday! So don't\nforget to bring Jou with you!
Sure!
Not you too, Taichi...
Take care of Jou, okay?
I won't be seeing you anymore, I\nsuppose.
Yeah. We didn't get to spend much\ntime together, but thanks.
I'm the one who should be thanking\nyou. Thanks for believing me, even\nwhen I was your enemy.
Well, Hikari believed in you, too.
You kept your promise. You said\nyou'd protect me...
Yeah. You're a really important\nfriend to us, Tailmon.
...Thanks, Taichi.
I have a lot of friends now, so I\ndon't need to worry anymore.
